_about: Bond Match graphics upgrade (docs/plans/bond-match-look/PLAN.md). Check with: python3 scripts/game_art.py bond-match paint OUT --dry-run

styles.s: Bright flat storybook illustration, clean simple shapes, soft gentle shading, sunny cheerful colours, smooth and tidy like a modern children's picture book or a friendly mobile game, made for children aged 7 to 11. No text, no letters, no numbers, no writing anywhere.

pictures.name: back-beach
pictures.prompt: A sunny New Zealand beach seen from the dunes: soft golden sand across the bottom half with three wide shallow rock pools of clear turquoise water ringed by smooth grey rocks, spread evenly left, middle and right, calm blue sea and gentle white waves behind, a few round clouds in a bright blue sky, a little driftwood and pale shells near the edges. Empty background scenery for a children's game, no people, no animals, the middle calm and uncluttered so things placed on top stand out. Wide landscape.

pictures.name: back-pool-day
pictures.prompt: Looking straight down into one big calm rock pool on a sunny day: clear light turquoise water filling almost the whole picture, a smooth pale sandy floor under the water with soft rippling sunlight patterns, a ring of rounded grey rocks, small pink seaweed and tiny shells only around the outside edges, the wide middle plain calm water. Empty background scenery for a children's game, no people, no animals, the middle calm and uncluttered so things placed on top stand out. Wide landscape.

pictures.name: back-pool-evening
pictures.prompt: Looking straight down into one big calm rock pool in the warm golden evening: clear water with a soft orange and violet sunset glow on its surface, a smooth sandy floor, a ring of rounded dark rocks with a few starfish and shells only around the outside edges, the wide middle plain calm water. Empty background scenery for a children's game, no people, no animals, the middle calm and uncluttered so things placed on top stand out. Wide landscape.

pictures.name: back-sunset
pictures.prompt: The edge of a rock pool beach at sunset: smooth rocks and golden sand across the bottom, a calm sea glowing orange and pink, a big soft sun low on the horizon, warm peaceful sky, the middle of the picture open and calm. Empty background scenery for a children's game, no people, no animals, the middle calm and uncluttered so things placed on top stand out. Wide landscape.
